title: Questions 172-175 refer to the following online chat discussion.
passage_1:
Deniz Yalcin (10:40 A.M.)
I’m currently tied up in a client meeting that is taking longer than anticipated. The catering service, Larkfield Express, is scheduled to stop by to give us the lunch samples for next month’s company retreat at 11:15 A.M. Is anyone free to accept them?

Ruth Amankwah (10:42 A.M.)
I would if I could, but I am having a meeting with the editorial team. We are selecting the final designs for the cover of the upcoming autumn cook book lines, and they need the approval for printing samples by noon.

Hiroshi Tanabe (10:43 A.M.)
I’m worried I cannot either. I will be unavailable until 12:30 P.M. because of a conference call with our clients.

Ana Beltran (10:45 A.M.)
I have nothing on then. I can go down to reception and meet the delivery driver.

Deniz Yalcin (10:46 A.M.)
Thank you! Please check that the delivery includes the vegetarian dishes we requested. We have several members with specific dietary requirements.

Ana Beltran (10:47 A.M.)
No problem. Do I need a list to double check?

Deniz Yalcin (10:48 A.M.)
Yes. I will forward it to this chat right away.
